newsitem.title: TANZANIA: Tanzania's Mkapa sacks officials for corruption.
newsitem.headline: Tanzania's Mkapa sacks officials for corruption.

text.p: Tanzania's President Benjamin Mkapa has sacked two senior regional officials for corruption, State House said on Wednesday.
Mkapa sacked regional development director Mary Luwilo and planning officer Frederick Shayo in Mtwara region, south Tanzania, it said in a statement.
The statement cited misappropriation of public funds, misuse of public property and maladministration.
Mkapa has been one of the loudest advocates of a government crackdown against official corruption, saying wrongdoers can expect no mercy.
